stem.text: A resistor X of resistance $40\,\Omega$ and a variable resistor are connected to a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $12\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $2.0\,\Omega$, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit: a battery of e.m.f. 12 V with internal resistance 2.0 ohm (dashed box), a variable resistor labelled 0-40 ohm, and a 40 ohm resistor labelled X, in series.

stem.text: The resistance of the variable resistor is changed from $0$ to $40\,\Omega$.
What is the change in power dissipated in resistor X?
